Python with comments, verify comment count

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"# This is a comment
# Another comment
def hello():
    # inline comment
    pass
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"comments":true,"language":"python"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config).expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.language);
    println!("{:?}", result.comments);
}
```
